goal: Ship something people use: a free, verified TypeScript 7 migration check (page + CLI)
notes: Idea: tsconfig TypeScript 7 readiness check. The rules came from typescript@6.0.3 lib/_tsc.js (checkDeprecations, computedOptions). Probes compiled all 239 single-option configs under tsc 5.9.3/6.0.3/7.0.2 (eval/option-matrix.json, replayed in CI by eval.test.mjs), which corrected three first guesses: 5.5-removed options are TS5023 in 7 at any value; module none and target es3 are TS6046; prepend is ignored by 7. A defaults probe showed 7 behaviour changes. Corpus eval: 61 configs (35 @tsconfig/bases versions, 9 fixtures, this repo's 17); the checker matched tsc 7.0.2 on 61/61; suggestions compiled clean on 61/61. tsc 7 rejects 28/61, including the current release of 7 of 25 @tsconfig/bases packages and 3 of this repo's Next apps. Local checks: node --test '*.test.mjs' 36 pass; check_posts.py clean; run_workflow_locally --for-changes first pass: 4 failures, all from this diff (post description 176 chars, report missing `kind` front matter, siblings budget orphan, .cjs probe files lacking a served type in check.mjs); fixed by shortening the description, adding front matter, a cyclehound<->tsconfig-ts7-check footer link pair with tests, and renaming the probes to .mjs. Re-ran: hub/content tests 62/62, test_doc_index OK, siblings 0 orphans and siblings.test 20/20, clean `node build.mjs` + `check.mjs` (1409 products, 11815 pages, no dead links), cyclehound page.test 7/7, tsconfig-ts7-check 37/37. Playwright smoke at 390 px: example renders 5 errors, suggestion folds baseUrl into paths, no console errors, no horizontal scroll.
